attributes.additional_details: There is a massive pothole on Stonehouse hill road and it is causing so many damages to people’s cars in the area, you have to dodge and swerve the pothole and when it is school times / rush hour it can become dangerous
attributes.background: To fix the massive pothole on Stonehouse hill b29

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for. Fixing potholes in your area is a matter for your local council.

You can report this pothole to Birmingham City Council here: https://www.birmingham.gov.uk/info/20110/report_road_and_pavement_issues/643/report_a_road_or_pavement_problem
